title: MOTION (PADILLA - SOTO-MARTINEZ) relative to amending Council action of September 8, 2026 (C.F. 26-1223) to replace the original instruction.
text:
[Council File 26-1223]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (PADILLA - SOTO-MARTINEZ) relative to amending Council action of September 8, 2026 (C.F. 26-1223) to replace the original instruction.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
AMEND the Council action of September 8, 2026 relative to funding for Council District 6's special recognition of El Grito, including the illumination of City Hall on September 15, 2026 (C.F. 26-1223), to replace the original instruction with the following new instruction:
TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $876 from the General City Purposes Fund No. 100/56, Account No. 00A28 (CD6 Council Projects) to the General Services Fund No. 100/40, Account No. 001100 (Hiring Hall), for services in connection with Council District 6's special recognition of El Grito, including the illumination of City Hall on September 15, 2026.
summary: Changes the funding for Council District 6's El Grito celebration, including lighting City Hall, by moving $876 from the district's council projects account to General Services.
